role: A-prime successor evidence and atomic post-core authority join
author: phase1a-evidence-successor-lane

authority.integrationAuthority: coordinator-only after independent combined rereview and separate CD-RT-5 disposition

reviewFindingTransfers.closure: EP6 recomputes one exact same-project C2/RI/manifest/seal authority chain before core.
Closed raw receipts and a unique ProjectId-scoped seal index construct the only opaque authority capability; post-core RunAuthorityIndex equality-rejoins that chain.
The retained closed wire grammar is regenerated over RT11's actual raw closure and EP6's corrected authority identities.
EP6/RT11 feed VERSIONING v6, then Evidence v5; the post-core authority index creates no semantic back-edge.
EP6 semantic commitments resolve to RT11 raw-only custody and the Evidence inventory is an exact projection of derived proof refs.

recursiveRequestIdExclusion.rule: RequestId and ExecutionId are operational-only. Every named semantic record is exact/closed; neither identity may occur at the root or any nested semantic item. Unknown fields reject rather than being ignored.
recursiveRequestIdExclusion.differential: Two RequestIds and distinct ExecutionIds over byte-equal semantic inputs and sealed target produce identical inventory, SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId, TerminalRun and runSealRef; they differ only in AttemptRunLinkV1 and operational records.
recursiveRequestIdExclusion.negativeControl: Inject requestId or executionId at each root and each nested semantic collection item; exact decoding/admission rejects before hashing or core authority use.

dependencies.dependencyDirection: EP6 and RT11 feed VERSIONING v6; Evidence v5 binds all three and adds only a post-core RunAuthorityIndexV1. VERSIONING v6 has no Evidence back-edge, so the graph is acyclic.

importedAuthorityContract.ownershipRule: Evidence imports the exact EP6 admission constructor and cannot allocate a competing authority recipe.

storeIndex.lookupRule: Exactly one row must match the full tuple; zero or multiple rows reject before capability construction.

dependencyGraph.cycleRule: acyclic; no RunId, TerminalRunV1, EvidenceDigest or post-core index endpoint is permitted

resolver: fetch exactly one typed SemanticObjectRecordV1 by (ProjectId,recordCasRef,recordKind)
verify RawCasRef equals SHA-256 of exact recordBytesHex bytes
closed-decode bytes as recordKind under the EP6 grammar
canonical byte-identical re-encode the decoded value
recompute semanticDomain commitment over the complete canonical record bytes and require semanticRef equality
semanticObjectBinding.bindingAuthority: DERIVED-WITNESS-ONLY; a binding without its raw target confers no capability
semanticObjectBinding.rawGraphRule: RawObjectRecordV3 and every RawObjectDependencyV2/RawDependencyEdgeV2 endpoint are RawCasRef; SemanticCommitmentRef is forbidden.

importedAuthorityContract.preCoreRule: admit_evaluation_authority is the only constructor; it returns only after every raw rehash, closed decode/re-encode, C2/RI recomputation, identity join, typed-edge check and unique store-index lookup succeeds
importedAuthorityContract.postCoreRule: RunAuthorityIndexV1 is derived only after core return and is committed atomically with TerminalRunV1, RunIndexV1, AttemptRunLinkV1, CustodyRootV1 and outbox publication.

scalarEncoding.text: NFC UTF-8, no BOM, non-empty, no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F; identifiers and enums retain their closed ASCII grammar
scalarEncoding.canonicalUnsignedDecimal: ASCII digits; zero is 0; otherwise no leading zero

recordRules.presence: every declared field exactly once; no optional or undeclared bytes
recordRules.sets: sort complete item record bytes unsigned; reject duplicates instead of silently deduplicating
recordRules.decoding: reject non-NFC, noncanonical decimal, tag/order/length mismatch, duplicate, omitted, unknown, trailing, or overlong bytes

RawProofInventoryV1.equalityRule: Exact projection of RT11 SemanticCapabilityClosureV3.proofRefs after requiring identityKind=raw-cas and every item ProjectId equal the outer ProjectId. Preserve recordCasRef, recordKind, and requiredForCapability exactly; zero items is permitted only when RT11 validates that capability.

TerminalRunV1.rawHashRule: runSealRef = sha256:<lowerhex SHA-256(exact TerminalRunV1 bytes)>; runSealRef is external and MUST NOT occur in TerminalRunV1.

commitments.canonicalJsonRawCas: sha256:<lowerhex SHA-256(opensip-canonical-json-v1(value))>; no domain, BOM, whitespace, or trailing newline

semanticJoins.preCoreAuthority: EP6 admit_evaluation_authority returns the only accepted opaque capability after exact same-project C2/RI/raw/store checks.
semanticJoins.retention: RawProofInventoryV1 equals RT11 semanticClosure.proofRefs exactly; all physical identities are RawCasRef.
semanticJoins.versioning: VERSIONING v6 historical and authority dependencies are already inside the same RT11 derived raw closure.
semanticJoins.terminalAuthority: TerminalRunV1 ProjectId, PlanId, PlanIntent commitment, ExecutionPlan commitment, ActivationManifest ref and EvaluationAuthoritySeal ref equal the admitted receipts exactly.
semanticJoins.postCoreIndex: RunAuthorityIndexV1 equality-rejoins TerminalRunV1 to PlanAuthorityReceiptV1 and EvaluationAuthorityAdmissionV1 inside the same atomic final transaction.

projection.name: EvidenceReadProjectionV1
projection.rule: Recompute on every stored read from verified persisted bytes plus RT11 UnitAvailabilityRecordV2 and VERSIONING v6 verifier availability. Never store, CAS-address, or include this projection in EvidenceDigest/RunId/TerminalRun.

calls: opensip_store.admit_evaluation_authority_seal_v1(ProjectStore, VerifiedPlanAuthorityV1, canonicalSeal, canonicalManifest, semanticBindings, semanticRecords) -> AdmittedEvaluationAuthoritySealV1
opensip_evidence.project_read_v1(VerifiedStoredRunV1, RT11 mutableState, VERSIONING v6 availability) -> EvidenceReadProjectionV1
apiContract.constructionRule: Constructors for opaque verified types are module-private. Core accepts only AdmittedEvaluationAuthorityV1. No overload accepts raw JSON, a supplied PlanId/RunId/ref, or verified/pinned booleans. Candidate RunId is an internal non-Display/non-Serialize value used only by commit_prepared_run_v1; only CommittedRunV1 exposes it.

RunIndexV1.uniqueness: append-only; same key/same runSealRef is idempotent; same key/different ref is LEDGER.CORRUPT

AttemptRunLinkV1.uniqueness: one Run per Attempt; many Attempts may link the same content-derived Run

RunCustodyRootV1.boundary: operational reachability/lineage outside EvidenceDigest; unitIds are exact RT11 UNIT-ID-V3 values

transaction: Resolve and rehash all raw CAS bytes; validate typed semantic bindings, EP6 bundle, RT11 closure, inventory equality, admitted target equality, custody preparation and Attempt expected revision.
Derive EvidenceDigest and an opaque candidate RunId; build TerminalRunV1; write Terminal bytes to a private staging namespace not served by public CAS lookup.

In one serializable transaction publish-or-verify Terminal CAS visibility, RunIndexV1, AttemptRunLinkV1, RunCustodyRootV1 and custody pin transfer; enqueue run-committed in the same outbox transaction; remove the prepared journal.
Return CommittedRunV1 only after commit. A transaction failure emits no RunId and leaves no public Run index or terminal object.
recovery: Before journal: hidden/orphan CAS is garbage-collectable and no Run exists.
Journal exists but no index/link: rehydrate SemanticEvidence and custody, rederive the same candidate, and retry.
Commit succeeded but response was lost: exact Attempt link and Run index return the committed result idempotently.
Index/link both exist with exact refs: success. Neither exists: retry. Exactly one exists, or either conflicts: LEDGER.CORRUPT; never guess or overwrite.
Concurrent semantically identical Attempts converge on one RunIndex/RunCustodyRoot and retain distinct AttemptRunLink/outbox rows.
storeContract.publicVisibility: Analysis events, logs, diagnostics, errors, responses and public CAS/index lookup forbid the candidate RunId before final commit. Stored-view may carry an already committed RunId and creates no new Run.

finalTransaction.precondition: all raw CAS objects and semantic closure bytes durable; Terminal and RunAuthorityIndex fully rederived and equality-joined
finalTransaction.visibility: RunId, Terminal, RunAuthorityIndex and outbox event become public together or none do
finalTransaction.retry: same keys and byte-identical values are idempotent; any RunIndex or RunAuthorityIndex collision with different bytes is corruption

admissionAndSealOrdering: Validate RequestId and resolve an explicit project retention policy plus admitted sealed-capability target before Attempt allocation. With CD-RT-5 unresolved, an absent default is REQUEST.UNSATISFIABLE and creates no Attempt.
Allocate ExecutionId/AttemptRecord and freeze PlanIntent, AdmissionDescriptor and sealed-capability target; RequestId/ExecutionId remain operational and outside semantic commitments.

Converge snapshot, derive/recompute PlanId and ExecutionPlan commitment, freeze Coverage/core inputs, derive ActivationManifest and EP6 EvaluationAuthoritySeal, and admit exact semantic bindings/raw records before core invocation.
Invoke pure core only with AdmittedEvaluationAuthorityV1; validate EP6 bundle and exact Coverage/universe/outcomes/proofs/verdict.

Derive RT11 semantic roots/bindings, typed raw proofRefs/edges, UNIT-ID-V3 units and RunId-free closure. Require sealedCapability equal the frozen target; prepare all required custody without downgrade.
Encode SemanticEvidence/EvidenceDigest, write the Run-free journal, and enter the atomic final commit protocol. Only committed publication exposes RunId.

sealedCapabilityContract.targetTiming: Frozen at request validation and committed in the admitted PlanIntent before Attempt/core. It cannot be selected after observing verdict or current availability.
sealedCapabilityContract.finalization: Final sealedCapability equals the admitted target exactly after RT11 closure and custody preparation. Unsupported target or failed custody does not silently demote; no Run commits.
sealedCapabilityContract.readTime: RT11 alone derives effectiveCapability from mutable raw-object availability. Availability, leases and lineage may change effectiveCapability but never sealedCapability, SemanticEvidence, EvidenceDigest, RunId or TerminalRun.
sealedCapabilityContract.productFork: CD-RT-5 alone decides the product default. This candidate supports explicit admitted targets and rejects an absent default; it does not claim or apply product acceptance.

d9Mapping.vocabularyRule: No new D9 class, code, axis, precedence, or exit mapping is introduced.

positiveControls.assert: Accepted EP6/RT11 vector reproduces every byte/hash above.
Two RequestIds and distinct ExecutionIds over equal semantic inputs/cap produce byte-identical inventory/Evidence/RUN/Terminal and one Run index with two Attempt links.
Removing one replay-only raw object changes only RT11 effectiveCapability/read projection; every persisted byte/hash remains exact.
Changing the admitted sealed target changes SemanticEvidence and RUN-ID-V1 even if every other scalar were equal.
Each documented crash point converges to no public Run or the one exact committed Run; no partial identity is observable.

authority: arbitrary PlanId even when downstream values are coherently recomputed
one semantic key mapped to multiple raw records
raw JSON or verified/pinned boolean bypass; core invocation count must remain zero
semantic: old EP4 semantic ref used as raw custody target
each lifecycle/mutable/physical field injected at root or nested depth
run: mutate each of the six framed fields
store: crash before stage/after stage/after journal/during transaction/after commit before response
RunAuthorityIndex included in EvidenceDigest or any pre-core/content identity cycle
versioning: current availability or effective capability copied into immutable semantics

invariants.assert: EvaluationAuthoritySealV1 is exact EP6-owned pre-core authority; unverified input never invokes core.
SemanticEvidence binds exact Project/Plan/seal, Coverage/universe/outcomes/proofs/verdict, raw proof inventory, sealed capability and RT11 closure without lifecycle or mutable state.
Semantic commitments and raw CAS refs are nominally distinct; only EP6 SemanticObjectBindingV1 resolves between them.
RT11 closure and UNIT-ID-V3 are content-derived and RunId-free; availability/lease/lineage/effective capability remain outside EvidenceDigest.
RUN-ID-V1 is exactly the six-field domain-framed digest and is externally visible only after atomic final commit.
TerminalRunV1 has no self-reference; external runSealRef is the raw exact-byte hash.
RunIndex, Attempt link, custody root and postcommit event publish atomically and recover idempotently.
VERSIONING v6 preserves v4 custody and Evidence binds exact EP6/RT11/VERSIONING v6 bytes without a dependency cycle.
Sealed capability is the pre-core admitted target, never a post-verdict maximum or silent downgrade.
RequestId/ExecutionId variation and current availability cannot change semantic bytes or content Run identity.

retainedResiduals: The packet is design-integrity evidence only; no runtime/store implementation was executed.
V10, CD-RT-5 and G19 remain unresolved/blocked.
Independent combined acceptance and product qualification remain absent; no seal/signoff is authorized.

runAuthorityIndexContract.derivation: After core return, closed-decode/rederive TerminalRunV1 and require every shared identity equal the admitted plan receipt and authority admission; then stage this exact row in the final transaction.
runAuthorityIndexContract.collisionRule: An existing (ProjectId,RunId) row must be byte-identical. Same key with any different authority/terminal field is corruption and publishes nothing.
runAuthorityIndexContract.cycleExclusion: RunAuthorityIndexV1 is post-content and is excluded from SemanticEvidenceV1, EvidenceDigest, RunIdentityPreimageV1, RunId, TerminalRunV1 and runSealRef. No pre-core RunId exists.

correlationDifferential.semanticInputs: byte-identical EP6 bundle, RT11 closure, admitted authority and canonical Evidence records

availabilityDifferential.mutation: remove one replay-only raw object from current RT11 availability
